title: UcasResultInboundV1
description: One qualification result from UCAS (Awarding Body Linkage), received by POST /api/v1/regulatory/ucas/results (Phase 3 D-15). Matched to the applicant's current offer by UCAS Personal ID; structured conditions get evidence suggesting meets or below, free-text conditions get it for review. A result with a future publishedOn is embargoed until then.
